cases.description: Should trigger: post-session review before merge
cases.input: What did we actually change this session? Quiz me before I merge.
cases.expect: Builds a 4-section change report then quizzes 5-8 questions, graded honestly
assertions: Groups 'what changed' by intent (feature/fix/refactor), not by file
Covers how the change interacts with existing code paths
Asks 5-8 questions targeting deviations, edge cases, interactions
Grades honestly: critical misses = fail even at 5/8
Explains each miss and flags gap vs too-clever

cases.description: Should trigger: verification of understanding before shipping
cases.input: I'm about to merge the deploy changes but I want to make sure I understand the retry behavior now.
cases.expect: Produces report + quiz weighted toward interaction effects
assertions: Mix of recall and prediction questions

cases.description: Not trigger: code review of someone else's diff
cases.input: Review this PR from our intern for style issues.

cases.description: Not trigger: session produced no changes
cases.input: Summarize what we learned in today's research-only session.
cases.expect: States no meaningful changes, does not fabricate a quiz
assertions: No quiz generated since nothing changed

cases.description: Should trigger: failed quiz re-quiz without softening the bar
cases.input: I got 5/8 last time and the miss was on how in-flight jobs behave during deploy. Quiz me again on that.
cases.expect: Treats prior near-pass with critical miss as a fail; offers a fresh variant quiz
assertions: Does not soften the bar for a critical miss
Points back to report sections on miss
